file_type: PE32+ (x86-64) Windows console executable (MinGW-w64 GCC 13, DWARF debug info embedded, 19 sections)

encryption_details.algorithm: Repeating-key XOR (single-byte XOR, key index = i % 18)
encryption_details.key_storage: Plaintext global g_xor_key in .rdata (RVA 0x4000 / file offset 0x2600); 18 bytes (0x12). The string doubles as an in-binary marker. The 64-byte payload g_encrypted_payload is at .data RVA 0x3000 / file offset 0x2400 and is XOR-decrypted in-place on the stack by xor_crypt() before injection.

anti_analysis: NtQueryInformationProcess ProcessDebugPort (class 7): if returned value == 0xFFFFFFFF, debugger detected -> WinMain returns 0 without injecting
NtQueryInformationProcess ProcessDebugFlags (class 0x1F): if returned value == 0, debugger detected -> silent exit
Indirect/dynamic resolution of native NT APIs (GetModuleHandleA('ntdll.dll') + GetProcAddress) to avoid IAT-based static detection
XOR-encrypted payload to defeat static string/byte-signature scanning of injected code
Silent failure (return 0) when NT API resolution or injection fails

injection_details.method: Ghost Process Hollowing (hasherezade-style) using native NT APIs: NtCreateProcess -> NtAllocateVirtualMemory -> NtWriteVirtualMemory -> NtCreateThreadEx -> NtResumeThread
injection_details.target_process: A suspended 'ghost' child process created by the malware itself via NtCreateProcess with the current process as parent (a clone of its own image; no separate EXE launched on disk)
injection_details.target_discovery: N/A - obtains a handle to itself via OpenProcess(PROCESS_CREATE_PROCESS=0x80, FALSE, GetCurrentProcessId()), then spawns the ghost child with NtCreateProcess
injection_details.payload_write: 64-byte XOR-decrypted stub written into the ghost process via NtAllocateVirtualMemory(MEM_COMMIT|MEM_RESERVE=0x3000, PAGE_EXECUTE_READWRITE=0x40) + NtWriteVirtualMemory; execution via NtCreateThreadEx(start=allocated base) + NtResumeThread, then WaitForSingleObject(hThread, 5000) and NtClose on both handles
injection_details.api_resolution: resolve_nt() resolves NtCreateProcess/NtAllocateVirtualMemory/NtWriteVirtualMemory/NtCreateThreadEx/NtResumeThread/NtClose at runtime from ntdll.dll
